query: i need my fathers original death certificate copy issued in florida to be authenticated by indian high commission
expected_key_facts: Mandatory documents for processing include: the Miscellaneous Application form, 2 passport-size color photos (51mm x 51mm, taken within 6 months), the original passport and a photocopy of both the deceased and the applicant, notarized proof of the applicant's valid US legal status, and a notarized proof of the applicant's US address.
Signature of the applicant on all documents must match the signature on their current valid passport.
Fee for attestation of a death certificate: consular fee $10.00 per copy + $2.00 ICWF per copy + VFS service fee $19.00, totaling $31.00 per application, with $10 for each additional copy.

query: Police Clearance Certificate
expected_key_facts: It is mandatory to complete VFS Online registration before sending the physical application; failure to do so results in the application being returned unprocessed.
Applicants log in and complete the application form on the government site https://embassy.passportindia.gov.in, then print and sign the completed PCC application form.
Applicants must provide their Indian address, including the name of the concerned police station, so police authorities can verify their antecedents.

Required documents include 2 recent passport-size color photos (51mm x 51mm, taken within 6 months) and a notarized color copy of proof of address (e.g., state-issued ID, driving license, utility bill, lease agreement) plus notarized proof of valid US status (e.g., green card, visa, EAD).
Incomplete or erroneous applications are returned to the applicant after 21 days if missing/additional documents are not provided, and must then be resubmitted.

query: global entry program
expected_key_facts: Global Entry is a US Customs and Border Protection (CBP) program that allows expedited clearance for pre-approved, low-risk travelers via automatic kiosks at select US airports.
Citizens of India are eligible for Global Entry.
Step 1: Apply through the US CBP Trusted Traveler Programs (TTP) website (https://www.cbp.gov/travel/trusted-traveler-programs/global-entry).

Step 2: After Step 1, applicants living in the USA submit the required information on the Global Passport Seva Project website (https://portal4.passportindia.gov.in) to complete a background check in India.
Step 3: Submit the physical application at the VFS Global Application Centre along with the applicable fee, per VFS guidelines.
